title: Decidir, Coincidir, Equivocarse
label: ch:es-plan
canDo: I can decide between two dates, say that one clashes, admit a mistake, say how long something takes, and name the evening meal.

payoff.summary: Read the notice or message this chapter's words exist for, then say the same thing back.
payoff.note: Second A2 vocabulary tranche, wordlist DERIVED FROM THE EXAM as in 431-436: spanish/mocks/a2/book-bounded-audit.json named the lexemes the two DELE A2 mocks need and the corpus does not teach. THE CHAPTER'S SPINE IS THE REFLEXIVE: equivocarse is almost never plain, because a mistake is something that happens TO a person, and the same shape covers caerse, olvidarse and perderse; coincidir takes the INDIRECT pronoun instead (me coincide), which is a different construction wearing a similar face. tardar closes a debt chapter 431 opened -- the retraso lesson used the verb in passing without teaching it.
